name: dk-bare-minimum
text:
Persondata

Vi passer godt på dine oplysninger. Vi bruger dem kun til at behandle din ordre og sender dig ikke reklamer, medmindre du har sagt ja.

Skriv til kontakt@lillebutik.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål.
reasoning: A Danish notice that is barely one. The controller is named without a way to reach it and the purposes are listed without a basis, so both are undetermined; the other ten elements are not there at all. The set’s floor: a reader must record two half-statements and ten absences rather than fill any of them in.
